name: azure-cloud-services
description: Expert knowledge for Azure Cloud Services development including troubleshooting, best practices, decision making, limits & quotas, security, configuration, and integrations & coding patterns. Use when managing Guest OS versions, Key Vault certs, .csdef/.cscfg configs, autoscale rules, or PowerShell automation, and other Azure Cloud Services related development tasks. Not for Azure Virtual Machines (use azure-virtual-machines), Azure App Service (use azure-app-service), Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) (use azure-kubernetes-service), Azure Functions (use azure-functions).
